name: Atlantis Anthem
description: Bright major-II build: a I-II-IV-I-V main loop where the major II is the signature color, plus a parallel-major planing coda. In C it is the Atlantis record (C-D-F-C-G main; C-A-D-B-F-D-G-E fade).
source: Donovan + Mickie Most (1966-69), via Ultimate Guitar chord sheets, from Atlantis
